title: NormalizedWaterRight
description: One row per water right × point of diversion, normalized across state record systems. Schema version rights-v1 — artifacts carry this id; consumers reject unknown versions. Semantic non-conflation rules (WATER_RIGHTS_DESIGN.md §2.5) are encoded as enums here, never re-derived downstream.

loc_quality.description: Location provenance. 'plss_approx' = derived from township/range/section; 'centroid' = admin-area fallback. Aggregation may use any; point display requires 'surveyed'|'gis'.

priority_date.description: The seniority date, in the sense the state system records it. NULL when the record has none — missing ≠ 1900.

priority_basis.description: What kind of instrument the priority rests on. NEVER compare seniority across bases without stating both.

use_classes.description: Controlled vocabulary; each state's native codes map onto this in the adapter, mapping tables committed beside the adapter.

quantity_kind.description: Rate vs volume vs storage — NEVER summed across kinds; artifacts aggregate within kind only.

owner_name_raw.description: Verbatim holder-of-record. PRESENT IN THE PARQUET, NEVER IN PUBLISHED ARTIFACTS when owner_entity_class = 'individual' (CI check enforces).

owner_entity_class.description: Classification per docs/WATER_RIGHTS_DESIGN.md D6; conservative default 'individual' when ambiguous (e.g. family LLCs stay 'entity' only on rule match).

status_class.description: Normalized from state status vocabularies; native status preserved in status_raw.
